title: When There Is No Trade
hook: Has price actually earned my entry?

launchpad.outcome: Walk the no-trade decision tree, and refuse to let beautiful context override missing execution.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Has price actually earned my entry?

slides.title: Walk it on this chart
slides.body: Answer each question for the chart above it.

miss.1: Look again: only wicks went through. No candle CLOSED above the PIL.

slides.stopWhy: No valid indication close. Has price earned my entry? No. WAIT.
slides.principle: HAS PRICE ACTUALLY EARNED MY ENTRY? If no: WAIT.

slides.headline: Beautiful narrative. No 1M ICC.
slides.line: Every context box is ticked. Look at the 1M.

slides.quote: Context doesn’t override execution. Has price actually earned my entry? If not: wait.

slides.prompt: Why can’t perfect context replace the 1M Dayli ICC?
slides.modelAnswer: Because context only makes me interested. Execution needs price to earn every step on the 1M. Without that, there is no entry, no matter how good the story looks.

remember: No trade is a decision too.
